_README: Dynasty Puck HQ commissioner settings. Edit this file on GitHub (pencil icon), then 'Commit changes'.
The site rebuilds itself about 3 minutes after you commit (GitHub Actions > 'Nightly data refresh').
Money is in $ millions. Seasons are written like '2026-27'. Keep the quotes, commas and brackets as they are;
if a commit breaks the file, the rebuild fails and the site keeps the last good version (you'll get an email).
See docs/COMMISSIONER.md for what every setting does and the once-a-year checklist.
capNote: 2026-27 $104.0M and 2027-28 $113.5M: NHL/NHLPA agreement. 2028-29 $127.5M: NHL projection to the Board of Governors (Elliotte Friedman, Sportsnet). Later seasons held at $127.5M (assumption; no published figure).
deadCapNote: Commissioner 2026-09-25/26: dropping a BID (or ELC) contract keeps 50% of its salary on the cap for every remaining contract year; dropping an FA contract costs nothing. RFA1 deals are assumed to count like BID (to confirm). Current penalties: raw/<season>/league/cap_penalties.csv.
goalieMinNote: Commissioner 2026-09-25: a team with fewer than 2 goalie GP in a week loses all four goalie categories.
gradNote: An MNR player who reaches the career-GP line stays at $0 for the rest of the season. If he's on the active roster he has to stay there; if he's in the minors he can stay there, but once he's promoted he can't be sent back down. In the offseason the team signs him to an ELC or releases him.

elc.note: Most ELCs are 2 years at $1.5M; a 1-year ELC has also been used.

elcExpiry._what: When an ELC is up: re-sign for N years at this AAV, or 1 more ELC year at 'extension1yr' (then UFA), or release.

rfa._what: When an RFA contract is up and the player is under 'ageLimit' on June 30: re-sign 2-6 years at base x premium (index = years - 1). The base can't go down.

initialAuctionRfa._what: First RFA deal for players from the 2025 initial auction (contract sheet 'Offseason Action' formula): AAV = mult x salary + base, by length 1-6 years. Their next RFA deal follows the 'rfa' rule above.

auctionBands._what: Winning bid ($M) -> contract years. Each set applies from that offseason until a newer set is added. [low, high or null, years]

playoffs.note: 8 teams, no byes. Division winners are seeds 1-2 (commissioner 2026-09-26); everyone else by category win%.

leagueDraft.order: Reverse standings: worst record picks 1st, champion 14th.

alerts._what: Opt-in alerts sent by GitHub Actions. ntfy topics are '<ntfyPrefix>-<team code>'. Email needs repository secrets (see docs/COMMISSIONER.md).
